sections.title: Executive Summary
fallback: Internal review — coverage universe and research process.
sections.prompt_addendum: Write 3-4 bullet points summarising the internal review. Focus on pipeline activity, process improvements, and resource allocation. Be concise.

sections.title: Performance Review
fallback: Review of pipeline throughput and delivery reliability.
sections.prompt_addendum: Write a concise paragraph (4-5 sentences) reviewing research pipeline performance. Cover: throughput, delivery reliability, and areas for improvement.

sections.title: Key Questions
sections.prompt_addendum: Write 4-5 questions for the internal review. Focus on: coverage gaps, process improvements, resource allocation, and team development.

sections.title: Risk Factors to Monitor
sections.prompt_addendum: Write 3 bullet points on internal process risks. Be specific.
